# Obrazovaka

> Comprehensive Russian school curriculum resource providing lesson notes, explanations, and tests for grades 5-11 across mathematics, languages, and sciences.

Obrazovaka is a Russian educational platform offering structured study materials aligned with the official school curriculum. It covers core subjects including algebra, English language, and biology, with grade-specific content and interactive testing tools to support student learning and homework preparation.

## Key Topics

- Algebra
- English Language
- Biology
- School Curriculum
- Grades 5-11
- Quadratic Equations
- Verb Tenses
- Grammar Lessons
- Cell Structure
- Animal Classification
- Lesson Notes
- Online Tests
- Irrational Numbers
- Modal Verbs
- Educational Content

## Algebra (Grades 7-11)

- [Algebra – Complete Curriculum Overview](https://obrazovaka.ru/algebra): Algebra lessons and notes for grades 7-11 per school curriculum
- [Algebra Grade 7](https://obrazovaka.ru/algebra/7-klass): Grade 7 algebra topics: expressions, equations, polynomials
- [Algebra Grade 8](https://obrazovaka.ru/algebra/8-klass): Grade 8 algebra: quadratic equations, irrational numbers, discriminant
- [Algebra Grade 9](https://obrazovaka.ru/algebra/9-klass): Grade 9 algebra: rational equations, vectors, functions, inequalities
- [Algebra Grade 10](https://obrazovaka.ru/algebra/10-klass): Grade 10 algebra: trigonometric equations and inequalities
- [Algebra Grade 11](https://obrazovaka.ru/algebra/11-klass): Grade 11 algebra: logarithmic equations, exponential functions
- [Algebra Tests Online](https://obrazovaka.ru/testy/po-algebre): Online algebra tests with answers for grades 7-11

## English Language (Grades 5-9)

- [English Language – Complete Curriculum Overview](https://obrazovaka.ru/english): English language lessons and notes for grades 5-9 curriculum
- [English Grade 5](https://obrazovaka.ru/english/5-klass): Grade 5 English: present tenses, active voice grammar
- [English Grade 6](https://obrazovaka.ru/english/6-klass): Grade 6 English: verb tenses, present/past perfect grammar
- [English Grade 7](https://obrazovaka.ru/english/7-klass): Grade 7 English: perfect tenses, past/future tense lessons
- [English Grade 8](https://obrazovaka.ru/english/8-klass): Grade 8 English: modal verbs, articles, grammar lessons
- [English Grade 9](https://obrazovaka.ru/english/9-klass): Grade 9 English: pronouns, verbs, adverbs, grammar topics
- [English Tests Online](https://obrazovaka.ru/testy/po-angliyskomu): Online English tests with answers and practice exercises

## Biology (Grades 5-8)

- [Biology – Complete Curriculum Overview](https://obrazovaka.ru/biologiya): Biology lessons and notes for grades 5-11 school curriculum
- [Biology Grade 5](https://obrazovaka.ru/biologiya/5-klass): Grade 5 biology: cell structure, biosphere, cell theory
- [Biology Grade 6](https://obrazovaka.ru/biologiya/6-klass): Grade 6 biology: plant kingdom, algae, seed plants
- [Biology Grade 7](https://obrazovaka.ru/biologiya/7-klass): Grade 7 biology: zoology, invertebrates, animal classification
- [Biology Grade 8](https://obrazovaka.ru/biologiya/8-klass): Grade 8 biology: human anatomy, skeletal, circulatory systems

## Student Support & Learning Tools

- [Questions & Answers](https://obrazovaka.ru/questions): Q&A platform for homework help across all school subjects
